modmenu.descriptionTranslation.ecoreward: Pays EcoBal money for mining blocks and killing mobs. A level that rises with progress multiplies the reward; rewards per block/mob, the XP curve and the level multiplier are configurable. Placed and generated blocks (cobblestone generators, pistons, ...) pay nothing.
ecorewards.language.name: English
config.ecorewards.title: EcoRewards Settings
config.ecorewards.ui.remote: You are playing on a server: these settings only apply to your own worlds. The server uses its own config/ecorewards.json.
config.ecorewards.ui.map_hint: One entry per line: key = value
config.ecorewards.ui.invalid: Some values are invalid (shown in red).
config.ecorewards.ui.discard.title: Discard changes?
config.ecorewards.ui.discard.message: Your changes to the settings have not been saved.
config.ecorewards.rewardInCreative.toolt: Players in creative mode earn nothing unless this is on.
Earned money is collected and paid out to EcoBal every this many seconds (0 = immediately), and right away when a player leaves. EcoBal writes its whole balance file on every deposit, so paying per block would strain the disk.
config.ecorewards.language.tooltip: Language of all texts for players who don't have the mod installed. Players with the mod see their own game language. Messages you have not changed switch along.
config.ecorewards.levels.xpBase.tooltip: XP needed for level N → N+1 = base × growth^(N−1) + increment × (N−1).
config.ecorewards.levels.xpGrowth.toolti: Factor per level in the XP formula; 1 = every level needs the same.
config.ecorewards.levels.xpIncrement.too: Fixed XP added per level in the XP formula.
config.ecorewards.levels.xpOverrides.too: Fixed requirements that replace the formula. One line per level: level = XP, e.g. 10 = 5000 (level 10 → 11 needs 5000 XP).
config.ecorewards.levels.xpOverrides.hin: One line per level: level = XP
config.ecorewards.multiplier.perLevel.to: Added to the multiplier for every level above 1 (0.05 = +5 %).
config.ecorewards.multiplier.max.tooltip: Upper limit of the multiplier; 0 = no limit.
config.ecorewards.multiplier.overrides.t: Fixed multipliers that replace the formula. One line per level: level = multiplier, e.g. 50 = 5.
config.ecorewards.multiplier.overrides.h: One line per level: level = multiplier
config.ecorewards.blocks.enabled.tooltip: Mining blocks pays money and XP.
config.ecorewards.blocks.requireCorrectT: Blocks that only drop with the right tool (ores, stone, …) pay nothing when mined without it.
config.ecorewards.blocks.matureCropsOnly: Wheat, carrots, nether wart, cocoa, berries, … only pay when fully grown.
config.ecorewards.blocks.defaultSkipsIns: The "default" entry does not apply to blocks that break instantly (grass, flowers, torches, …); listed blocks still count.
config.ecorewards.blocks.rewards.tooltip: Money and XP per block, before the level multiplier. One line per entry: id or #tag = money, xp (e.g. minecraft:zombie = 2.5, 3). An exact id wins over tags, tags count from top to bottom, "default" covers everything else; remove it to reward only listed entries.
config.ecorewards.blocks.rewards.hint: One line per entry: block id, #tag or default = money, xp
config.ecorewards.mobs.enabled.tooltip: Killing mobs pays money and XP. A kill counts when a player dealt the final blow or hit the mob shortly before (knocked into lava, killed by a tamed wolf, …).
config.ecorewards.mobs.spawnerMultiplier: Money and XP of mobs from monster spawners are multiplied by this (0.25 = a quarter).
config.ecorewards.mobs.rewards.tooltip: Money and XP per mob, before the level multiplier. One line per entry: id or #tag = money, xp (e.g. minecraft:zombie = 2.5, 3). An exact id wins over tags, tags count from top to bottom, "default" covers everything else; remove it to reward only listed entries.
config.ecorewards.mobs.rewards.hint: One line per entry: entity id, #tag or default = money, xp
config.ecorewards.antiExploit.ignoreArti: Blocks that did not generate with the world pay nothing: placed by players, pushed by pistons, fallen sand, cobblestone/obsidian from lava and water, ice, snow golem trails, … Grown crops and blocks set with commands (/setblock, /fill) still count.
config.ecorewards.antiExploit.naturalGro: Blocks that count as natural when they grow on their own (trees, sugar cane, melons, …). Ids or #tags, one per line.
One block id or #tag per line
config.ecorewards.messages.showRewardAct: Shows money, level and progress above the hotbar after every reward.
config.ecorewards.messages.reward.toolti: Action bar after a reward with money. Placeholders: {player}, {money}, {gainedXp}, {level}, {multiplier}, {xp}, {xpNeeded}, {progress}. & color codes and &#RRGGBB work; empty = no message.
Action bar after a reward without money. Placeholders: {player}, {money}, {gainedXp}, {level}, {multiplier}, {xp}, {xpNeeded}, {progress}. & color codes and &#RRGGBB work; empty = no message.
config.ecorewards.messages.progress.tool: Text of {progress}; here only {xp} and {xpNeeded} work.
config.ecorewards.messages.progressMaxLe: Text of {progress} and {xpNeeded} once the highest level is reached.
config.ecorewards.messages.levelUp.toolt: Chat message to the player after a level up. Placeholders: {player}, {money}, {gainedXp}, {level}, {multiplier}, {xp}, {xpNeeded}, {progress}. & color codes and &#RRGGBB work; empty = no message.
Plays the level-up sound for the player.
config.ecorewards.messages.broadcastLeve: Tells all players when someone reaches a new level.
config.ecorewards.messages.levelUpBroadc: Message to all players when announcing is on. Placeholders: {player}, {money}, {gainedXp}, {level}, {multiplier}, {xp}, {xpNeeded}, {progress}. & color codes and &#RRGGBB work; empty = no message.
config.ecorewards.messages.info.tooltip: What /ecorewards and /lvl show a player about themselves. Placeholders: {player}, {money}, {gainedXp}, {level}, {multiplier}, {xp}, {xpNeeded}, {progress}. & color codes and &#RRGGBB work; empty = no message.
config.ecorewards.messages.infoOther.too: What /ecorewards info <player> shows operators. Placeholders: {player}, {money}, {gainedXp}, {level}, {multiplier}, {xp}, {xpNeeded}, {progress}. & color codes and &#RRGGBB work; empty = no message.
